description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mansoor Delane has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Delane was able to return to practice this week. He'll still miss a second straight game.
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Trent McDuffie is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: McDuffie had missed practice to start the week. He'll need to be monitored heading into Sunday.
items.title: Trent McDuffie (back) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jordan Whittington is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Whittington remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Jordan Whittington (back) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson is expected to return for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Ferguson returned to practice this week. He'll be activated from injured reserve by Saturday.
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) expected to play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Yaya Diaby has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Diaby remains sidelined with a sprained MCL.
items.title: Yaya Diaby (knee) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bucs coach Todd Bowles said Emeka Egbuka will be a game-time decision on Sunday.
items.impact: Egbuka was able to return to a full practice on Thursday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into the weekend.
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (foot) to be game-time decision Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tristan Wirfs is expected to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Wirfs was on the injury report with a toe issue. He'll be good to go against a revamped Bears defensive line.
items.title: Tristan Wirfs (toe) expected to play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Browns.
items.impact: Tyson was limited in his return to practice this week. He will have a chance to be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. will play in Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Fannin was added to the injury report on Thursday with a groin issue. He'll remain a TE1 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) will play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns plan to sign Sam Kamara to their active roster.
items.impact: Kamara will add depth at defensive tackle for Cleveland.
items.title: Sam Kamara to sign with Browns active roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Whyle did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Whyle remains in concussion protocol.
items.title: Josh Whyle (concussion) not practicing Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sean Rhyan did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Rhyan is expected to avoid injured reserve. He'll still likely be sidelined on Sunday.
items.title: Sean Rhyan (ankle) misses practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zaire Franklin did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Franklin will likely be ruled out on the official injury report.
items.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) misses practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said they'll see how Greg Van Roten feels Saturday and make a decision on his status.
items.impact: Van Roten had his practice window opened. He'll have a chance to make his return on Sunday.
items.title: Greg Van Roten (hamstring) to have decision made on status Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said they'll see how Mack Hollins feels Saturday and make a decision on his status.
items.impact: Hollins will need to be activated from injured reserve by Saturday if he is good to go.
items.title: Mack Hollins (calf) to have decision made on status Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Maliek Collins has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Collins remained sidelined from practice on Friday.
items.title: Maliek Collins (elbow) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Browns head coach Todd Monken said Shedeur Sanders will start at QB for the on Sunday.
items.impact: Deshaun Watson is listed as questionable as he remains in concussion protocol, but it appears Sanders will start either way. The Browns pass catchers become a bit riskier with Sanders behind center.
items.title: Shedeur Sanders will start Sunday for Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Marcus Jones is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Jones missed practice on Thursday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.
items.title: Marcus Jones (foot) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Hunter Henry is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Henry did not practice on Wednesday or Thursday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.
items.title: Hunter Henry (foot) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) has been ruled out for Sunday's contest between the New England Patriots and Green Bay Packers according to Evan Lazar.
items.impact: Henderson will not suit while continuing to battle ongoing illness issues for head coach Mike Vrabel, with Rhamondre Stevenson once again expected to receive a sizeable workload out of the New England backfield against the Packers Sunday.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Deshaun Watson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Watson returned to practice on Friday. He will have till Saturday to clear concussion protocol.
items.title: Deshaun Watson (concussion) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's matchup between the New England Patriots and Green Bay Packers according to Evan Lazar.
items.impact: Brown will sit out after being unable to take the practice field for head coach Mike Vrabel, with DeMario Douglas in line for increased targets against targets as the No. 1 wideout against the Packers Sunday.
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) ruled out for Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bam Knight has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Knight remains in concussion protocol. Tyler Allgeier will take over the workhorse role in a tough matchup against Seattle.
items.title: Bam Knight (concussion) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. was not seen at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Reed is dealing with a hip injury. He will need to be monitored on the injury report.
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) not seen at practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DJ Wonnum was not seen at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Wonnum remains in concussion protocol.
items.title: DJ Wonnum (concussion) not seen at practice Friday
